llm_response.reason: The website https://www.jimgreenitalia.com/ has several red flags indicating it could be a scam. Although it appears to be selling legitimate Jim Green products, the privacy policy page returned a 404 error, and there were SSL certificate issues detected, which is a significant security concern. Additionally, the legitimacy of the contact information and the 'Info & Contatti' page is unverified. The presence of SSL certificate issues and a missing privacy policy page are critical indicators of a potential scam.
